title: Morzinski et al. (2015): Magellan Adaptive Optics first-light observations of the exoplanet beta Pic b. II. 3-5 micron direct imaging with MagAO+Clio, and the empirical bolometric luminosity of a self-luminous giant planet

evidence.locator: Abstract: from the bolometric luminosity and an age of 23 +/- 3 Myr, hot-start tracks give a mass of 12.7 +/- 0.3 Jupiter masses, a radius of 1.45 +/- 0.02 Jupiter radii and Teff 1708 +/- 23 K; log(L/Lsun) -3.78 +/- 0.03
